dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Have you looked up? The bookshelves above our heads are inverted, and there are carpets, tables, and chairs on the ceiling...

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But what if we shift our perspective?

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Perhaps that is the true floor, and we are simply suspended in the sky by the magic of those sagacious ladies.
